requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-5361-5929--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

401-3944-5933-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-5933-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

891-997-8207.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5900-6097-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5900-6097-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

2281-6132-8095.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

280-833-3827-5607.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
280-833-3827-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Golgari Rot Farm, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

223-2655.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{R} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
223-2655.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
223-2655.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Fury Storm by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Fury Storm and choosing to copy the original Fury Storm.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Fury Storm copy, creating a copy of Fury Storm.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

2685-3197-3263-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3197-3263-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3821-4415-5921.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
3821-4415-5921.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2488-3614-7167.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Heroic Intervention by paying its mana cost, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
If the opposing creature dealt damage to Apex Altisaur, Apex Altisaur's second ability and Wrathful Raptors trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 4 until your opponents control no creatures. If they happen to control an indestructible creature with power above 0, this loop can be done infinitely.
2488-3614-7167.notes: You can restart the loop if opponents control creatures by dealing damage to Apex Altisaur. It may not have indestructible by this point however unless you use another source to provide it.

4050-4094-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-4094-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4149-4599-4871-5434-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3711-4222-5268.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

5147-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
5147-7096--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

513-4444-6896.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland permanent card in hand that costs {2} or less.
You control a nontoken nonland permanent that costs {2} or less.
513-4444-6896.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a nonland permanent card that costs {2} or less.
Cast the permanent from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {0} due to Green Goblin.
Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another nonland permaennt that costs 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-7267.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-7267.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

2440-3399-4399-6097.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Hinterland Sanctifier triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

3912-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

5232-5718-6927.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Damage Control Crew.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Damage Control Crew.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Damage Control Crew.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1482-4708-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1482-4708-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2558-3490-4050-6701-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-4050-6701-6797.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

5394-6291-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1636-5914-6635.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{W}{U}.
1636-5914-6635.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Cast Ambrosia by paying {1}{W}.
When Ambrosia enters the battlefield, it, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Ambrosia trigger, returning Clement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Clement by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Clement enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning Ambrosia from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5914-6635.notes: You can tap Frogs for mana thanks to Clement. This should be factored in when determining if you have enough mana to execute the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

3609-4896-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have a repeatable way to allow Kilo to tap.
3609-4896-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
3609-4896-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well.

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3129-3951-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create two token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-2457-4094-4885.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-2457-4094-4885.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

148-1339-6466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
148-1339-6466.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Shocking Sharpshooter, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1432-2085--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
1432-2085--80.description:
If Kelpie Guide is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Kelpie Guide to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide and another legendary creature.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

997-4871-5695-6019.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from steps 3 and 7, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

500-914-2921-3125-4867.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
500-914-2921-3125-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dockside Extortionist and the token Cormela trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding four mana.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

146-169-366.description:
Cast Pact of the Titan choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times, paying a total of {0}.
Pact of the Titan's replicate ability triggers, causing you to copy Pact of the Titan for each time the replicate cost was paid.
Resolve the first Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.
When the Giant enters the battlefield, Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Pact of the Titan.

2104-3341.notablePrerequisites: Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2104-3341.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

283-2872-5062.notablePrerequisites:
Porcuparrot is mutated on top of Clever Conjurer.
Illusionist's Bracer is attached to Clever Conjurer.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
283-2872-5062.description:
Activate the Porcuparrot pile, tapping it to untap itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying the Porcuparrot ability.
Resolve the copy of the ability, untapping the Porcuparrot stack.
Holding priority, activate the Porcuparrot pile by tapping it to deal damage equal to the amount of times it has mutated to any target.
Resolve the original Porcuparrot untap ability, untaping it.
Repeat.

7-539-1899-2232-3678.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
7-539-1899-2232-3678.description:
Cast Beastcaller Savant for {G}, triggering Retreat to Emeria and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Retreat to Emeria's trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
The Kor Ally token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Tap Beastcaller Savant, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand.
Repeat.

1978-3151-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.

1457-1851-2499-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four additional mana-producing lands.
1457-1851-2499-3821.description:
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Quarry Beetle.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself twice.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Endless Sands and up to four other lands.
Activate your other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Endless Sands and up to four other lands.
Activate your other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Endless Sands's last ability by tapping it, paying {4}, and sacrificing it, returning Peregrine Drake and Quarry Beetle from exile to the battlefield.
When Quarry Beetle enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice.
When Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, it triggers itself twice.
Resolve the first Quarry Beetle trigger, returning Endless Sands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Quarry Beetle trigger, returning up to one target land of your choice from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Quarry Beetle.
Repeat from step 4.

3229-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
3229-4423-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Time Warp on top of your library.
Activate Kefnet the Mindful by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
